title: Drop native-separator expectations in decisions tests (follow-up to wcpf-3)
action: In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/decisions/tests.rs: after wcpf-3 made path_relative emit forward slashes on every platform, three tests still translate expected paths to native separators and are red on Windows (CI run 31947061772). At ~1099-1102 rewrite the expected message literal to plain docs/decisions/index.md and drop the .replace('\\', MAIN_SEPARATOR_STR); at ~1174 and ~1702 remove the native closures and use the forward-slash literals directly.
goal: render_writes_atomically_and_check_reports_drift, supersede_sweeps_docs_inherits_metadata_and_queues_stubs, log_touches_sweeps_docs_excludes_index_and_own_history_queues_the_rest green on windows-latest; Linux stays green.
notes: Test-only; expectations align with the forward-slash canon wcpf-3 set.
